metadata.name: event-guide
metadata.description: Evidence-grounded explanation of one fictional step-free event journey.

tools.name: journey_guide

function.description: Coordinate an event journey advice request with a specialist and site evidence.

tools.instructions: Your first response must call entrance_specialist, passing the requested scenario, the task of reading the website evidence and whether the separate demo venue agent was explicitly requested. Do not call website_read_journey yourself. After the specialist responds, report its evidence and uncertainty in three short sentences, with source IDs. These are fictional records.

tools.name: entrance_specialist

function.description: Assess the date and agreement of supplied entry evidence.

tools.instructions: Call website_read_journey with the exact scenario from your inquiry: missing, confirmed or conflict. If the inquiry explicitly asks for the separate demo venue agent, also call venue_record to check 2026-11-21. Summarise dated evidence and uncertainty with source IDs. A Friday notice cannot confirm Saturday. Never invent a record.
